log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Grimmsnarl

decisions.rationale: Lead Whimsicott + Ampharos to immediately threaten Pelipper with Thunderbolt and disrupt with Prankster Taunt/Encore. Rain weakens Charizard-Y, so Mega is deferred until Pelipper is removed. Archaludon backs with Electric coverage and Sturdy, Grimmsnarl provides Light Screen to survive Water spam. Must eliminate Pelipper turn one to neutralize rain.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs Pelipper/Swampert-Mega rain + Incineroar/Gholdengo/Klefki/Farigiraf. Pelipper Drizzle overwrites Charizard-Y Drought, weakening Fire 50% and forcing Solar Beam to charge. Pelipper and Swampert both resist Heat Wave. Gholdengo resists Solar Beam and is immune to Encore/status (Good as Gold). Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks Prankster. Incineroar Fake Out outspeeds Prankster. Charizard-Mega-Y not viable primary win condition against rain core. Strong Electric/Grass coverage needed to threaten Pelipper/Swampert. Must remove Pelipper early to eliminate rain control. Game 2: Opponent has Klefki and Farigiraf available. Plan: Lead Ampharos + Whimsicott to threaten Pelipper with Thunderbolt and disrupt with Taunt/Encore. Archaludon + Grimmsnarl back for Electric coverage and Light Screen. Mega Charizard-Y only after Pelipper is KOed.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Swampert-Mega. Lead Pelipper+Swampert for immediate Rain+Swift Swim—Swampert-Mega outspeeds the entire opposing roster under Rain. Pelipper Protect blocks Archaludon Electro Shot (guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper) while Swampert EQ chunks Archaludon 43-90%. If Pelipper is pressured, switch to Gholdengo (survives Electro Shot 38-61%, immune to Encore/Taunt via Good as Gold). Back Incineroar provides Intimidate+Fake Out to manage Quaquaval Aqua Step speed boosts. Rain overrides Charizard
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Charizard-Mega-Y (Timid, Solar Beam/Heat Wave/Air Slash/Protect, Charizardite Y), Whimsicott (Timid, Prankster, Encore/Moonblast/Energy Ball/Taunt, Focus Sash), Grimmsnarl (Impish, Prankster, Taunt/Light Screen/Foul Play/Protect, Light Clay), Archaludon (Modest, Sturdy, Thunderbolt/Flash Cannon/Dragon Pulse/Electro Shot, Wise Glasses), Ampharos (Modest, Plus, Thunderbolt/Dragon Pulse/Thunder Wave/Protect, Leftovers), Quaquaval (Jolly, Moxie, Aqua Step/Close Combat/Ice Spinner/Protect, Life Orb). Key calcs verified Game 2: Archaludon Electro Shot in Rain = one-turn (Rain skips charge), guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper (4x Electric), 38-61% on Gholdengo (neutral, survives). Swampert-Mega EQ on Archaludon = 43-90% spread (2HKO). Swampert-Mega Rock Slide on Charizard-Y = 64-157% (possible OHKO). Pelipper Hydro Pump on Charizard-Y = 99-215% (possible OHKO, 88% acc with Wide Lens). Grimmsnarl Foul Play on Swampert-Mega = 30-48% (survivable). Whimsicott Energy Ball on Pelipper = 23-42% (non-threatening). Swampert-Mega Swift Swim under Rain (150-244 effective Spe) outspeeds entire opponent roster including Charizard-Y (115-167) and Quaquaval base (99-150); Quaquaval after Aqua Step +1 (149-225) can outspeed Swampert-Mega. Rain overrides Drought on Pelipper entry; Solar Beam needs charge turn in Rain. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status moves (Encore, Taunt, Thunder Wave, Light Screen). Series: p2 leads 1-0. Game 1 opponent brought Charizard-Y/Whimsicott/Grimmsnarl/Archaludon, led Grimmsnarl+Archaludon. Plan: Swampert-Mega is primary win condition under Rain

decisions.rationale: Encore on Pelipper with Prankster priority locks it into Hydro Pump/Hurricane, preventing Wide Guard or Protect spam. Ampharos Thunderbolt is 4x SE and should KO or cripple Pelipper, removing rain control. This focuses fire to eliminate the win condition enabler before Mega Swampert can sweep.
decisions.notebook: Opponent runs Pelipper/Swampert-Mega rain core with Incineroar/Gholdengo/Klefki/Farigiraf support. Pelipper Drizzle sets rain, weakening Fire and enabling Swift Swim Swampert. Gholdengo immune to Encore/status (Good as Gold). Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks Prankster. Incineroar Fake Out outspeeds Prankster. Game 2 plan: Lead Ampharos + Whimsicott to Encore/Thunderbolt Pelipper for removal. Archaludon + Grimmsnarl back for Electric coverage and Light Screen. Mega Charizard-Y only after Pelipper is KOed. Must remove Pelipper early to eliminate rain control and enable Charizard-Y sweep.

selection: Earthquake (all adjacent, including ally Pelipper) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Ampharos Thunderbolt is a guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper (124-550%), so Protect is mandatory. Swampert Mega Evolves to gain Swift Swim (150-244 effective Spe, outspeeds all foes at priority 0) and Earthquake hits Ampharos 2x SE while Pelipper is immune via Flying. Even if Whimsicott uses Energy Ball (4x), Swampert-Mega moves first and likely survives the 49-190% range. Next turn Swampert-Mega cleans under Rain with Swift Swim.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 Turn 1: Leading Pelipper+Swampert vs Whimsicott+Ampharos. Ampharos Thunderbolt = guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper (4x Electric). Swampert-Mega EQ on Ampharos = 48-183% spread (possible OHKO). Whimsicott Energy Ball on Swampert-Mega = 49-190% (possible OHKO but Swampert-Mega outspeeds via Swift Swim). Pelipper Flying immunity protects from ally EQ. Plan: Mega Swampert as Swift Swim win condition under Rain; Pelipper resets Rain on re-entry. Gholdengo and Incineroar both take 2x from Ground — avoid switching into ally EQ. Opponent backline: Charizard-Y, Grimmsnarl, Quaquaval, Archaludon.

decisions.rationale: Energy Ball has 73.9-190% on Swampert-Mega (likely OHKO), removing the Swift Swim threat. Ampharos at 12% HP dies to any Earthquake roll, so Protect is mandatory. This line safely pressures the biggest threat while keeping Ampharos alive for future turns.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Pelipper/Swampert-Mega rain core. Pelipper Protect rate reduced after turn 1. Swampert-Mega Earthquake is primary spread threat. Game 2 plan: remove Swampert-Mega with Grass coverage, then pivot to Archaludon/Grimmsnarl for Electric support and screens. Encore failed turn 1 due to Protect. Focus Sash on Whimsicott intact. Must eliminate rain control before Mega Charizard-Y sweep.

decisions.rationale: Switch Pelipper to Gholdengo: dodges Encore (Good as Gold blocks all status moves), Ground immunity makes ally EQ safe. Swampert EQ KOs Ampharos (11%, 2x SE) and chips Whimsicott. If Encore hits Swampert instead, forced EQ is identical to selected move. Energy Ball risk exists but Encore is the more likely opponent play (guaranteed priority vs uncertain speed contest).
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent leads Whimsicott+Ampharos. Whimsicott is Timid FocusSash Prankster with Encore/Moonblast/EnergyBall/Taunt. Tried Encore on Pelipper T1 (blocked by Protect). Ampharos Modest Leftovers Plus with Thunderbolt/DragonPulse/TWave/Protect. Opponent backline: Charizard-Y (Drought threat to Rain), Grimmsnarl (Prankster LightClay screens+Taunt), Quaquaval (Jolly LifeOrb Moxie), Archaludon (Modest WiseGlasses Sturdy). Key: Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Encore/Taunt/TWave entirely and is Ground-immune — ideal partner for Swampert EQ. Preserve Swampert-Mega as Swift Swim wincon; Pelipper re-enters to reset Rain if Drought overrides. Watch for Charizard-Y switch to kill Rain and Swampert speed.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar is the clear pick: Intimidate support, resists both Whimsicott's STABs, and better long-term into backline (Charizard, Grimmsnarl, Quaquaval). Pelipper is SE-weak to both active foes and Rain already has 4 turns. Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status, so it's safe this turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent leads Whimsicott+Ampharos. Whimsicott Timid FocusSash Prankster (Encore/Moonblast/EnergyBall/Taunt) — Sash broken T1 by EQ, now at 64%. Ampharos Modest Leftovers Plus (Thunderbolt/DragonPulse/TWave/Protect) at 17%. Backline: Charizard-Y (Drought threat to Rain, Timid, 115-167 Spe), Grimmsnarl (Prankster LightClay screens+Taunt, Impish, 65-112), Quaquaval (Jolly LifeOrb Moxie, 99-150), Archaludon (Modest WiseGlasses Sturdy, 90-137). Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Encore/Taunt/TWave entirely — ideal vs Prankster-heavy team. Swampert-Mega fainted T2 to Energy Ball. Key wincon now: Gholdengo Make It Rain KOs Whimsicott (89%+ min roll > 64% HP) and likely chips/KOs Ampharos at 17%. Preserve Pelipper for Rain reset if Charizard-Y Drought activates. Incineroar Intimidate + Fake Out valuable for backline matchups.

decisions.rationale: Grimmsnarl resists Make It Rain (0.5x), Shadow Ball (0.25x), and Flare Blitz (0.5x), providing a safe switch-in for the dying Ampharos. Whimsicott's Prankster Encore on Incineroar locks it into Fake Out, Flare Blitz, Parting Shot, or Protect for 3 turns, disrupting opponent momentum while preserving Whimsicott's Focus Sash and Prankster utility for future turns.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 plan: remove rain control, pivot to Archaludon/Grimmsnarl for Electric support and screens. Encore failed turn 1 due to Protect. Swampert-Mega eliminated turn 2 with Energy Ball. Gholdengo has Good as Gold (immune to status), so Encore/Taunt only work on Incineroar. Grimmsnarl (Dark/Fairy) resists Gholdengo and Incineroar attacks, has Prankster for screens/status. Archaludon (Steel/Dragon) has Sturdy and resists Make It Rain but is weak to Flare Blitz. Focus Sash on Whimsicott intact. Must eliminate rain control before Mega Charizard-Y sweep. Opponent Pelipper Protect rate reduced after turn 1.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon in slot 1 resists Gholdengo's STABs and can attack immediately with ElectroShot in the rain. Ampharos in slot 2 avoids Incineroar's super effective Flare Blitz while threatening with Thunderbolt. This positioning maximizes survivability against Fake Out and Make It Rain.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 plan: Archaludon and Ampharos are the remaining win cons. Archaludon must stay away from Incineroar's Flare Blitz. Gholdengo has Good as Gold, so status moves fail. Rain is up for 3 turns, enabling Archaludon's ElectroShot to fire immediately. Opponent has Klefki and Farigiraf in the back, both capable of setting screens or Trick Room. Pelipper can reset rain. Must eliminate Gholdengo and Incineroar to clear the path.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3 priority) flinches Ampharos before it can Protect or TWave, dealing 7-21% chip. Make It Rain then guaranteed-KOs Whimsicott (89.8%+ > 64%) and, combined with Fake Out chip, guaranteed-KOs Ampharos at 17% (min combined 23.9% > 17%). Whimsicott cannot stop Gholdengo (Good as Gold blocks Encore/Taunt; all its damage is 0.5x). Double KO leaves 2v2 with both my Pokémon at full HP against opponent backline.

Archaludon Electro Shot on Incineroar pressures the biggest threat (18.3-85.2% damage). Ampharos Protect keeps it safe at 18% HP from Flare Blitz KO or spread damage. Even if Incineroar outspeeds, Archaludon survives Flare Blitz and retaliates. Gholdengo's -2 SpA makes Make It Rain weak (12.2-64% spread) and Shadow Ball not guaranteed OHKO. This preserves both Pokémon while eliminating Incineroar threat.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon and Ampharos are win conditions. Archaludon must avoid Incineroar Flare Blitz. Rain enables Electro Shot immediate fire. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status. Opponent back: Klefki (screens), Farigiraf (Trick Room), Pelipper (rain reset). Priority: eliminate Incineroar and Gholdengo. Ampharos vulnerable at low HP, needs protection. Archaludon speed 105 vs Incineroar 65-112 creates speed uncertainty.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo Protects to avoid potential ElectroShot OHKO (its +1 SpA boost pushes damage into OHKO range). Incineroar Parting Shot lowers Archaludon's SpA, canceling ElectroShot's boost for next turn, and safely pivots to Pelipper for rain reset. Next turn Shadow Ball KOs Ampharos at 17%. Risk: if opponent targets Incineroar, Sitrus Berry + possible survival keeps Parting Shot live.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent backline Charizard-Y (Drought threat) + Quaquaval (Moxie LifeOrb). Archaludon Sturdy prevents OHKO at full HP. ElectroShot in rain = one turn with +1 SpA before damage — massive threat, must Protect or eat potential OHKO. Pelipper 4x weak to Electric, careful with positioning vs Archaludon. Wincon: KO Ampharos (17%) with Shadow Ball, then wear down Archaludon through Sturdy with Flare Blitz/Shadow Ball while maintaining rain. Preserve Pelipper for Drought override when Charizard-Y enters. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status (Encore/Taunt/TWave).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Archaludon Electro Shot is a guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper in rain (103-556%). Ampharos at 24% HP is vulnerable to Gholdengo Make It Rain even at -2 SpA, so Protect ensures survival. Archaludon alone secures the KO, removing rain setter and major threat while preserving Ampharos for endgame.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon and Ampharos are win conditions. Rain enables Electro Shot immediate fire. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status. Opponent back: Klefki (screens), Farigiraf (Trick Room). Priority: eliminate Pelipper and Gholdengo. Ampharos vulnerable at low HP, needs protection. Archaludon speed 105 creates speed uncertainty vs Incineroar 65-112 (fainted). After Pelipper KO, rain ends; Archaludon can use Thunderbolt vs Gholdengo or Flash Cannon vs Klefki. Ampharos can Thunder Wave or Dragon Pulse from back.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Ball guaranteed KOs 23% Ampharos even at SpA -2 (33.5-76.7% range). Pelipper Protect blocks 4x Electric from Archaludon/Ampharos — reliable since last used turn 1. If both foes target Pelipper, their turn is wasted. Removing Ampharos cuts one Electric threat; Pelipper preserved at 100% to reset rain when Charizard-Y's Drought arrives. Speed uncertainty vs both foes makes Protect mandatory over tanking.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent backline Charizard-Y (Drought) + Quaquaval (Moxie LifeOrb). Archaludon Sturdy prevents OHKO at full HP. ElectroShot in rain = one turn with +1 SpA before damage — massive threat, must Protect or eat potential OHKO. Pelipper 4x weak to Electric, careful with positioning vs Archaludon. Wincon: KO Ampharos with Shadow Ball, then wear down Archaludon through Sturdy with Flare Blitz/Shadow Ball while maintaining rain. Preserve Pelipper for Drought override when Charizard-Y enters. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status (Encore/Taunt/TWave). Gholdengo SpA -2 from Make It Rain turn 3 — Shadow Ball still KOs low HP targets but Make It Rain damage negligible until stats recover. Rain ending after turn 5 — plan to cycle Pelipper out and back in to re-trigger Drizzle when Charizard-Y sets Drought.

decisions.rationale: Thunderbolt is guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper with +1 SpA and Wise Glasses. Removes rain setter and leaves favorable 1v1 vs weakened Gholdengo. Archaludon resists both Pelipper attacks, so even if Protect blocks, position remains strong. Gholdengo's -2 SpA makes Shadow Ball non-guaranteed OHKO.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon win con with +1 SpA and Wise Glasses. Thunderbolt KOs Pelipper 100%. Gholdengo -2 SpA, Good as Gold blocks status. Opponent back: Klefki (screens), Farigiraf (Trick Room). After Pelipper KO, Archaludon 1v1 Gholdengo with Thunderbolt (neutral) or Flash Cannon/Dragon Pulse (0.5x). Archaludon speed 105, Gholdengo 89-136 range. Ampharos fainted turn 5.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper is 4x weak to Electric and must leave. Gholdengo Protects to avoid potential OHKO from Drought-boosted Heat Wave if Charizard-Y enters (46-153% range). Incineroar switches in safely, Intimidate softens Quaquaval's Moxie if it arrives. Next turn: break Archaludon Sturdy with Shadow Ball + Flare Blitz, then bring Pelipper back to override Drought with Drizzle.
decisions.notebook:
Game 2: Opponent remaining: Archaludon (100%, Sturdy, SpA+1, Atk-1, Wise Glasses, Modest 90-137 Spe), Charizard-Y (Drought, Solar Beam/Heat Wave/Air Slash/Protect, Timid 115-167 Spe), Quaquaval (Moxie Life Orb, Aqua Step/Close Combat/Ice Spinner/Protect, Jolly 99-150 Spe). My remaining: Gholdengo (100%, SpA-2, Leftovers, Modest 104 Spe), Pelipper (100%, Wide Lens, Drizzle, Modest 85 Spe), Incineroar (68%, Sitrus consumed, Intimidate, Careful 80 Spe). Swampert fainted.

Key facts: Ghost is NEUTRAL vs Steel (Gen6+ nerf) — Shadow Ball is neutral vs Archaludon, not NVE. Shadow Ball with SpA-2 does ~18-57% to Archaludon (breaks Sturdy, no KO). Drought Heat Wave does 46-153% to Gholdengo (possible OHKO). Incineroar Flare Blitz is neutral vs Archaludon (Fire: 2x Steel × 0.5x Dragon = 1x). Quaquaval Aqua Step is 2x SE vs Incineroar (Water vs Fire). Gholdengo immune to Quaquaval Close Combat (Ghost). Incineroar resists Heat Wave (Fire/Dark takes 0.5x Fire). Pelipper Hydro Pump 2x SE vs Charizard-Y; Hurricane 2x SE vs Quaquaval.

Wincon: (1) Break Archaludon Sturdy with Shadow Ball/Flare Blitz, (2) KO Archaludon, (3) Bring Pelipper in to override Drought with Drizzle, (4) Hydro Pump Charizard-Y / Hurricane Quaquaval. Must KO or force out Archaludon before Pelipper re-enters (4x Electric weak). Gholdengo is irreplaceable as Quaquaval Close Combat immune switch — do not sack it recklessly.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon should target Incineroar with Dragon Pulse to maximize the chance of a KO before it can use Parting Shot and pivot. Gholdengo is at -2 SpA and poses minimal threat, making Incineroar the priority target to prevent stat drops and a free switch.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon win con with +1 SpA and Wise Glasses. Gholdengo -2 SpA, Good as Gold blocks status. Opponent back: Klefki (screens), Farigiraf (Trick Room). Incineroar at 32% HP, Sitrus consumed. Archaludon speed 105, Incineroar 65-112 range. Ampharos fainted turn 5. Whimsicott and Grimmsnarl fainted earlier.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out priority +3 flinches Archaludon, preventing Thunderbolt/Electro Shot. Shadow Ball breaks Sturdy (~20-52% with SpA-2). Next turn Flare Blitz+Shadow Ball (46-106%) finishes. If foe 2 appears, worst case Gholdengo falls to Heat Wave but Sturdy is broken; Pelipper cleans up. Preserves wincon line.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 damage ranges (SpA-2 Gholdengo): Shadow Ball ~20-52% Archaludon (breaks Sturdy, no KO). Flare Blitz 26-54% Archaludon (neutral). Archaludon Thunderbolt w/ SpA+1 ~24-38% Incineroar (possible KO at 33%). Charizard-Y Heat Wave in sun 76-115% Gholdengo (possible OHKO); in rain ~38-58% (safe). Pelipper Drizzle (85 Spe) slower than Charizard-Y (115-167) so rain overrides Drought. Wincon: (1) Break Sturdy, (2) KO Archaludon, (3) Pelipper rain overrides Drought, (4) Hydro Pump Charizard-Y / Hurricane Quaquaval. Gholdengo irreplaceable as Quaquaval Close Combat immune switch. If game 3: opponent team is Whimsicott/Ampharos/Grimmsnarl/Archaludon/Charizard-Y/Quaquaval; key threats are Prankster Encore/Taunt from Whimsicott+Grimmsnarl, Archaludon Electro Shot setup, Charizard-Y Drought Heat Wave, Quaquaval Moxie snowball.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar at 32% HP is priority target. Thunderbolt deals 31.2-88.4%, chance to KO and remove Intimidate. Fake Out fails turn 8 (not first turn out), so Incineroar likely Flare Blitz (19.3-80.7% into my 64%, risky but necessary). KOing Incineroar leaves -2 SpA Gholdengo manageable for win con.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon win con +1 SpA Wise Glasses. Fake Out fails after first turn out. Incineroar Sitrus consumed. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status, -2 SpA. Opponent back: Klefki (screens), Farigiraf (Trick Room). Archaludon speed 105 outspeeds most foes. Thunderbolt neutral on both Steel-types, best damage option. Electro Shot skips turn, risky vs two foes.

decisions.rationale: Gholdengo must Protect — Charizard-Y Heat Wave in sun is guaranteed OHKO (59.6-261%). Incineroar Parting Shot into Archaludon: even though Archaludon outspeeds and may KO Incineroar at 33%, if Incineroar survives it lowers Archaludon's Atk/SpA and safely pivots to Pelipper (Drizzle overrides Drought). Parting Shot switch is safest Pelipper entry since Incineroar tanks incoming hits, not Pelipper (who is 2x weak to Thunderbolt). If Incineroar dies, Gholdengo survives via Protect and Pelipper ente
decisions.notebook: Game 2 damage ranges (SpA-2 Gholdengo): Shadow Ball ~20-52% Archaludon (breaks Sturdy, no KO). Flare Blitz 26-54% Archaludon (neutral). Archaludon Thunderbolt w/ SpA+1 ~13-59% Incineroar (possible KO at 33%). Charizard-Y Heat Wave in sun 60-261% Gholdengo (guaranteed OHKO); in rain ~38-58% (safe). Pelipper Drizzle (85 Spe) slower than Charizard-Y (115-167) so rain overrides Drought. Archaludon guaranteed faster than Incineroar (90-137 vs 80). Wincon: (1) Break Sturdy [done—Archaludon at 64%], (2) KO Archaludon, (3) Pelipper rain overrides Drought, (4) Hydro Pump Charizard-Y / Hurricane Quaquaval. Gholdengo irreplaceable as Quaquaval Close Combat immune switch. If game 3: opponent team is Whimsicott/Ampharos/Grimmsnarl/Archaludon/Charizard-Y/Quaquaval; key threats are Prankster Encore/Taunt from Whimsicott+Grimmsnarl, Archaludon Electro Shot setup, Charizard-Y Drought Heat Wave, Quaquaval Moxie snowball. Parting Shot is safest Pelipper pivot since Incineroar tanks hits instead of Pelipper (2x weak to Thunderbolt).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Electro Shot fires immediately in Rain and guarantees OHKO on 4x-weak Pelipper. Removes Drizzle and Hurricane/Hydro Pump threat. Gholdengo at -2 SpA only does 15-64% with resisted Make It Rain, leaving Archaludon alive to clean up.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon win con +1 SpA Wise Glasses. Electro Shot fires immediately in Rain. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status only, -2 SpA. Opponent back: Klefki (screens), Farigiraf (Trick Room). Archaludon speed 105 outspeeds most foes. Pelipper 4x weak to Electric, guaranteed OHKO from Electro Shot in Rain. Gholdengo Make It Rain at -2 SpA does 15-64% on Archaludon (resisted spread).

decisions.rationale: Pelipper must Protect—Archaludon outspeeds (90-137 vs 85) and Thunderbolt is guaranteed 4x OHKO with SpA+1. Gholdengo Shadow Balls Archaludon for ~18-57% chip (SpA-2), setting up next-turn KO. If Charizard-Y comes, Gholdengo falls to Heat Wave but Pelipper survives with Hydro Pump for 2x SE on Charizard-Y. If Quaquaval comes, both survive and Archaludon is weakened for KO next turn. Gholdengo Protect unreliable (used last turn).
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Down 0-1, Gholdengo SpA-2 makes Shadow Ball ~18-57% on Archaludon (tool omits boosts; halve raw output). Archaludon Thunderbolt guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper (4x, SpA+1). Pelipper Drizzle only on entry—once Charizard-Y Drought activates, rain is permanently gone (no switch available). Charizard-Y Heat Wave in sun OHKOs Gholdengo; in rain ~38-58% (safe). Pelipper slower than Charizard-Y (85 vs 115-167). If game 3: opponent team Whimsicott/Ampharos/Grimmsnarl/Archaludon/Charizard-Y/Quaquaval. Key: prevent Electro Shot setup, keep rain up vs Drought, Gholdengo is Quaquaval Close Combat immune switch. Archaludon Sturdy must be broken before KO attempts. Whimsicott+Grimmsnarl Prankster Encore/Taunt is major threat—Fake Out immune to Encore (Incineroar Ghost? No, Incineroar is Fire/Dark, Encore should work but Incineroar was immune—check if Parting Shot was locked). Opponent tends to Protect predictably and play patiently with weather wars.

decisions.rationale: Electro Shot into Pelipper is a guaranteed OHKO (4x weak, Rain-boosted, +2 SpA, Wise Glasses). Removes the Rain source and leaves only a -2 SpA Gholdengo, which cannot threaten Archaludon's Sturdy or deal significant damage with weakened Make It Rain/Shadow Ball. Archaludon then cleans up with Thunderbolt or Flash Cannon.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Archaludon win con at +2 SpA Wise Glasses. Electro Shot fires immediately in Rain. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status only, -2 SpA. Opponent back: Klefki (screens), Farigiraf (Trick Room). Archaludon speed 105 outspeeds most foes. Pelipper 4x weak to Electric, guaranteed OHKO from Electro Shot in Rain. Gholdengo Make It Rain at -2 SpA does 15-64% on Archaludon (resisted spread). After Pelipper KO, Rain ends; Archaludon can Thunderbolt or Flash Cannon Gholdengo. Sturdy prevents OHKO from full HP but irrelevant at 35%. Priority: remove Rain source first, then clean up Gholdengo.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Wide Guard at +3 priority reliably blocks Charizard-Y Heat Wave (the double-KO threat if Drought enters). Shadow Ball targets 35% Archaludon; with SpD-1 the adjusted range ~29-87% can KO. If Gholdengo outspeeds and KOs, Pelipper is also saved from Thunderbolt. Even if Archaludon outspeeds and KOs Pelipper, Gholdengo survives behind Wide Guard. Best coverage of worst-case lines.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Down 0-1. Tool confirms Ghost is 1x on Steel in this format (not 0.5x). Shadow Ball with SpA-2 vs Archaludon SpD-1: adjusted ~29-87%, can KO at 35%. Wide Guard always succeeds (doesn't check 1/X counter) but increments it to X=9, making future Protect nearly impossible. If game 3: opponent team Whimsicott/Ampharos/Grimmsnarl/Archaludon/Charizard-Y/Quaquaval. Key priorities: prevent Electro Shot setup, keep rain up vs Drought (Pelipper Drizzle only on entry—once Charizard-Y Drought activates rain is permanently gone), Gholdengo is Quaquaval Close Combat immune (Ghost). Archaludon Sturdy must be broken before KO attempts. Whimsicott+Grimmsnarl Prankster Encore/Taunt is major threat. Opponent tends to Protect predictably and play patiently with weather wars. Charizard-Y Heat Wave in sun OHKOs Gholdengo; in rain ~38-58% (safe). Pelipper slower than Charizard-Y (85 vs 115-167).

reflections.summary: The team preview plan was fundamentally flawed: I brought four Pokemon designed to overwhelm the rain core (Pelipper/Swampert) with Archaludon as the sole win condition, but had no reliable answer to Gholdengo. Grimmsnarl's Foul Play could have pressured Gholdengo, but it was eliminated early without impacting that matchup. Incineroar's Intimidate + Parting Shot + Fake Out chipped Archaludon down, and Gholdengo's Shadow Ball KO'd Archaludon simultaneously with Pelipper on Turn 10, leaving no Pok
reflections.adjustment: Bring a dedicated Gholdengo answer (a Ground- or Dark-type attacker, or a Pokemon with Earth Power / Crunch) instead of a redundant rain attacker like Ampharos. If no such Pokemon is available, preserve Grimmsnarl specifically to Foul Play Gholdengo, and do not commit Archaludon until Incineroar's Intimidate support is removed.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's core: Pelipper (Drizzle, Wide Lens, Modest) + Swampert-Mega (Adamant) rain, with Gholdengo (Good as Gold, Leftovers, Modest, Recover) as the primary special attacker and win condition. Incineroar (Sitrus Berry, Intimidate) is used for early-game cycling: Fake Out + Parting Shot to lower opponent's stats and pivot. Gholdengo is immune to status (Good as Gold) and Steel-type (immune to paralysis); must be handled with super effective Dark/Ground moves or overwhelming force. Opponent has Trick Room (Farigiraf, Mental Herb, Armor Tail) and dual screens (Klefki, Light Clay) as backup plans. Pelipper is 4x weak to Electric; Electro Shot in Rain guarantees OHKO. Archaludon's Electro Shot is the primary rain abuser, but lacks coverage for Gholdengo (no Dark/Ground moves). Future plan: Bring a Dark- or Ground-type attacker to handle Gholdengo; do not rely on Archaludon alone to clean up after Pelipper. Preserve Grimmsnarl's Foul Play for Gholdengo if no better option is available.

reflections.summary: Gholdengo was the MVP, repeatedly landing Shadow Ball to chip and eventually KO Archaludon while staying healthy behind Protect and Leftovers. Incineroar's Parting Shot and Intimidate helped manage Archaludon's ramping SpA. Swampert-Mega fainted early with minimal contribution, making this effectively a 3v6 carried by Gholdengo and Incineroar's utility. The opponent's predictable Protect patterns and lack of a clean Gholdengo answer sealed the result.
reflections.adjustment: Swampert-Mega was dead weight this game; question whether the rain Mega core is the right call versus weather-archetype opponents where Gholdengo and Incineroar do all the work. Also, Pelipper's final-turn Wide Guard was suboptimal against single-target Electro Shot—Protect would have preserved Pelipper longer and kept rain up.
reflections.notebook: Series complete; won 2-0. Durable opponent tendencies: favors weather-archetype teams built around Archaludon Electro Shot setup with Prankster Encore/Taunt support (Whimsicott+Grimmsnarl); plays patiently and Protects predictably in weather wars. Archaludon Sturdy must be broken before KO attempts. Gholdengo is the premier answer to this opponent—Ghost typing grants Close Combat immunity and Shadow Ball reliably chips Steel-types. Swampert-Mega underperformed and may not justify the Mega slot vs this archetype. Pelipper is slower than Charizard-Y (85 vs 100+), so rain can be permanently overwritten if Charizard-Y enters.
